finding.expected: Resolve local pending RUNs through exact correction continuity before declaring them competing with remote history. A unique exact active correction child returns WAIT; the same child with a valid local terminal awaiting transport returns RETRY_TRANSPORT; unrelated or multiple tips still fail closed.
finding.issue: Unified State treats any local active or locally-terminal-but-untransported RUN as ambiguous whenever any canonical remote terminal for the TASK already exists. That is incorrect for an admitted REMEDIATION or REPAIR child whose canonical parent necessarily remains in remote history, so valid correction children are reported BLOCKED instead of WAIT or RETRY_TRANSPORT.
